comment: C-first source mission for music.c:do_improvisation(MAGIC_HARP) -> charm_monsters. The preceding independent recipes recorded a wrong item selection and a startup --More-- page that consumed Ctrl-W. This recipe begins with a space to clear any startup page, wishes a two-charge harp, creates a hostile orc, and applies the harp in the C-observed f slot before choosing improvisation. The C monster state and charm outcome establish whether the target branch is reached; resistance remains a valid target miss.
